name: znetwork_dplay_send_ex_unreliable_tracked
description: zNetworkDPlay::SendExUnreliableTracked forwards a packet through DirectPlay SendEx, tracks the async handle, and cancels an outstanding packet-6 send when needed.
known_limits: The smoke uses a fake DirectPlay provider for SendEx and CancelMessage behavior; tier S verification is deferred to a zNetwork source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48ad70 validates packet type 6 selecting flags 0x200, other packet types selecting flags 0x600, outstanding packet-6 cancellation through DirectPlay slot 0xcc when g_zNetwork_LastSendExCompleted is clear, SendEx slot 0xc4, local-player source key, async handle storage in g_zNetwork_LastSendExHandle, DPERR_PENDING acceptance, and zNetwork_DPlay::ReportError at source line 0x25a on negative HRESULT.

The native zNetwork packet-send smoke verifies packet-6 cancellation, async handle update, packet-6 flags, non-packet-6 flags, and preservation of g_zNetwork_LastSendExCompleted for non-packet-6 sends.
